text: A song; a psalm of the Korahites. For the leader; according to Mahalath. For singing; a maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
I Lord, the God of my salvation, I call out by day;at night I cry aloud in your presence. [AA]
Let my prayer come before you;incline your ear to my cry. [AB]
t[1]For my soul is filled with troubles; [AC]my life draws near to Sheol.
I am reckoned with those who go down to the pit;I am like a warrior without strength.
My couch is among the dead,like the slain who lie in the grave.You remember them no more;they are cut off from your influence.
You plunge me into the bottom of the pit,into the darkness of the abyss.
Your wrath lies heavy upon me;all your waves crash over me. [AD]Selah
II Because of you my acquaintances shun me;you make me loathsome to them; [AE]Caged in, I cannot escape;
my eyes grow dim from trouble.All day I call on you, Lord;I stretch out my hands to you.
t[2]Do you work wonders for the dead?Do the shades arise and praise you? [AF]Selah
III Is your mercy proclaimed in the grave,your faithfulness among those who have perished? [3]
Are your marvels declared in the darkness,your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?
IV But I cry out to you, Lord;in the morning my prayer comes before you.
Why do you reject my soul, Lord,and hide your face from me?
I have been mortally afflicted since youth;I have borne your terrors and I am made numb.
Your wrath has swept over me;your terrors have destroyed me. [AG]
All day they surge round like a flood;from every side they encircle me.
Because of you friend and neighbor shun me; [AH]my only friend is darkness.
